tool.name: QuantVPS
tool.description: QuantVPS sells servers in Chicago for futures platforms such as NinjaTrader, Tradovate and MultiCharts. Plans are sized by how many charts or strategies you run at once.
features: Chicago location, with the site quoting 0.52 ms network latency to CME
Plans from a small starter server up to a dedicated machine
Remote desktop, with setup described as under a minute
Annual billing is listed at 20 percent off the monthly price

plans.name: VPS Starter
plans.detail: Guidance: 0 to 1 charts or strategies. 4 GB RAM, 50 GB NVMe.

plans.name: VPS Lite
plans.detail: Guidance: 1 to 3 charts or strategies. 8 GB RAM, 75 GB NVMe.

plans.name: VPS Pro
plans.detail: Guidance: 3 to 5 charts or strategies. 16 GB RAM, 150 GB NVMe.

plans.name: VPS Ultra
plans.detail: Guidance: 5 to 10 charts or strategies. 32 GB RAM, 300 GB NVMe.

plans.name: Dedicated
plans.detail: Guidance: 10 or more charts or strategies.

tool.pricing_note: Standard monthly prices from the official homepage on 11 Oct 2026. Annual billing saves 20 percent. A higher-priced option is also on the page. The FAQ mentions a 14-day money-back window.
